name: poeltl70
caption:
WHY FEWER MINUTES? 🎮🏀 Jakob Poeltl shot 70.0% last season. Now he's playing his fewest minutes in years.

• 2024-25: career highs, 14.5 PPG and 9.6 RPG
• 2025-26: 70.0% from the field, his career best
• His 8 games this season: 22.8 minutes, 8.5 PPG, 64.6% shooting
• Collin Murray-Boyles, 21, first 9 games: 22.1 minutes, 10.7 PPG

Should Poeltl still be our starting center? 👇

beats.head: WHY FEWER MINUTES?
beats.name: POELTL
beats.vo: Jakob Poeltl shot seventy percent from the field last season. So why are his minutes down?

beats.head: CAREER HIGHS
beats.name: POELTL
beats.vo: The year before: career highs, fourteen point five points and nine point six rebounds.

beats.head: HIS 8 GAMES
beats.name: POELTL
beats.vo: Now he's thirty-one. In his eight games: about twenty-three minutes and eight and a half points a night, his fewest minutes since twenty nineteen.

beats.head: THE KID
beats.name: COLLIN
beats.vo: Meanwhile, twenty-one-year-old Collin Murray-Boyles is scoring ten point seven in about the same minutes.

beats.head: STARTER?
beats.vo: Should Poeltl still be our starting center? Comment below.
